answer: Anchor every agent identity to one hardware root: a TPM chip endorsement key, so one chip holds exactly one identity. First, the agent submits a signed TPM attestation at registration. Second, it locks a $50 refundable bond for 60 days. Third, proven spam burns the bond and blacklists that chip forever, while a public registry lists live chips. Forging 10,000 identities means buying 10,000 TPM chips at $25 each plus $500,000 in bonds: $750,000 and 60 days of waiting. Like marble trees in an orchard, each identity is solid, counted, and rooted, and no hollow copy can take its place.
